_note: Medians from the earlier measurements (data/prior_results/g_lp_anatomy.html, cc_compaction.html). Lp = prompt right after compaction (full, incl. the cached fixed prefix); L0 = fixed prefix that stays cached across compaction; g = per-turn prompt growth (model tokenizer); m = number of full-context reads by the summary call(s); summary_out = summary output tokens per compaction. Use as priors / sweep starting points, not as truths for a new model.
